intent: Evidence-led follow-up: keep the reviewed portrait directions that worked, generalize them across real Second Rite subjects, and test only small surface questions that fit the reliable 512 pipeline. Large event/location and creature directions are deliberately deferred after the prior run's owner ratings and Forge timeouts.
